module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params)
          @output_path = File.expand_path(params[:output_path] || params[:path])
          @path = params[:path]
          @verbose = params[:verbose]
          @password = params[:password]
          @symlinks = params[:symlinks]
          @include = params[:include]
          @exclude = params[:exclude]

          @output_path += ".zip" unless @output_path.end_with?(".zip")
        end

        def run
          UI.message("Compressing #{path}...")
          inspect_zip_request
          create_output_dir
          run_zip_command
          UI.success("Successfully generated zip file at path '#{output_path}'")
          output_path
        end

        def create_output_dir
          output_dir = zip_output_directory
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(output_dir)
        end

        def run_zip_command
          Dir.chdir(zip_working_directory) do
            Actions.sh(*zip_command)
          end
        end

        def zip_command
          command = [zip_command_binary, "-#{compose_zip_option_flags}"]
          append_zip_password_arguments(command)
          basename = zip_archive_basename
          command << output_path
          command << basename
          command = append_zip_include_arguments(command, basename)
          command = append_zip_exclude_arguments(command, basename)
          command
        end

        def zip_command_binary
          @path
          "zip"
        end

        def compose_zip_option_flags
          zip_option_letters
        end

        def zip_option_letters
          flags = verbose ? "r" : "rq"
          flags += "y" if symlinks
          flags
        end

        def append_zip_password_arguments(command)
          password_argument_tokens.each { |token| command << token }
          command
        end

        def password_argument_tokens
          secret = password
          return [] unless secret
          ["-P", secret]
        end

        def zip_archive_basename
          File.basename(@path)
        end

        def zip_working_directory
          File.expand_path("..", @path)
        end

        def zip_output_directory
          File.expand_path("..", output_path)
        end

        def append_zip_include_arguments(command, basename)
          patterns = include
          unless patterns.empty?
            command << "-i"
            command += collect_zip_include_tokens(basename, patterns)
          end
          command
        end

        def append_zip_exclude_arguments(command, basename)
          patterns = exclude
          unless patterns.empty?
            command << "-x"
            command += collect_zip_exclude_tokens(basename, patterns)
          end
          command
        end

        def collect_zip_include_tokens(basename, patterns)
          map_zip_filter_paths(basename, patterns)
        end

        def collect_zip_exclude_tokens(basename, patterns)
          map_zip_filter_paths(basename, patterns)
        end

        def map_zip_filter_paths(basename, patterns)
          prefix = basename.to_s.empty? ? File.basename(@path) : basename
          patterns.map { |entry| File.join(prefix, entry) }
        end

        def source_parent_directory
          File.expand_path("..", @path)
        end

        def describe_zip_output_target(raw_path = nil)
          target = raw_path.nil? ? @output_path : raw_path
          text = target.to_s
          if text.empty?
            :empty
          elsif text.end_with?(".zip")
            :zip_file
          elsif File.directory?(text)
            :directory
          else
            :file
          end
        end

        def classify_archive_source_kind(source_path = nil)
          raw = source_path.nil? ? @path : source_path
          text = raw.to_s
          extension = File.extname(text).downcase
          if text.empty?
            :missing
          elsif File.directory?(text)
            text.end_with?(".xcarchive") ? :xcarchive : :directory
          elsif File.file?(text)
            [".zip", ".ipa", ".apk"].include?(extension) ? :archive_file : :file
          else
            :relative
          end
        end

        def inspect_zip_request
          survey_zip_helpers
          classify_archive_source_kind(@path)
          describe_zip_output_target(@output_path)
        end

        def self.perform_artifact_copy(params)
          allocate.execute_artifact_copy(params)
        end
